sections.title: Intent
sections.text: Atomically remove shared test harnesses from production autoload and make every affected package suite self-contained.

sections.title: Why
sections.text: D33/D94 and `@plan/knowledge/research-P16-design.json` §10; Composer dependency `autoload-dev` does not propagate, so a partial cross-package migration is knowingly broken.

sections.title: Scope Included
sections.text: core/auth-or-access/tasks/crm/intl/search-intl/tenancy/tasks-workflow and root test bases; autoload-dev/scripts; deletion of transitional src/Testing carriers; D33 exception removal.

sections.title: Scope Excluded
sections.text: Runtime classes/behavior, new package, production test namespace, test semantics, database migrations and unrelated test refactors.

sections.title: Files
sections.text: `packages/core/src/Testing/**`→`packages/core/tests/Support/**`; affected packages' `src/Testing/**`, `tests/**`, `composer.json`; root `tests/**`; root `composer.json`; D33 gate/exception carriers; `@plan/knowledge/findings-P16-testing-boundary-receipt.json`.

sections.title: Implementation Rules
sections.text: Atomic cross-package exception to one-package moves; each package Testbench base is local; root may map core tests explicitly; no dependency test namespace imports.

sections.title: Code Guidance
sections.text: Add/migrate local bases first, run package suites, then remove old production carriers and exception, rebuild all autoloaders and rerun.

sections.title: Validation
sections.text: Every affected package test command from its package root green; root `composer test:packages` green; production Testing import/autoload sweep empty; strict Composer checks; isolated DB safety tests green.

sections.title: Deliverables
sections.text: Closed D33/N09, package-local test harnesses and exact positive/negative sweep receipt.
